statement: The unchanged MovieLens service-affinity live scenario reaches PASS while ready-lease admission remains owner-authored, quorum-bounded, and fail-closed.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

Before a live run, prove red-on-revert through the real UnifiedRebalancer checkRebalance path that nodes-p1 is blocked before the classification change and may plan only when a recovery-eligible quorum exists; retain an ordinary system-partition control that remains blocked.

Do not synthesize, extend, or override a ready lease; do not mark an unready node ready; do not weaken quorum, explicit lease-clear fencing, or ordinary system-partition admission. The intervention may only let nodes-p1 use the existing bounded priority-recovery lane.

System-table recovery membership remains owned by the canonical declarative classification set, and consumers or fixtures must derive inventory from that set rather than duplicate a hand-maintained table list.

Do not change the MovieLens 180000ms schema budget, 60000ms stability window, workload, joins, preload size, ratings-only split policy, report conversion, retry duration, operation deadlines, concurrency budgets, or live scenario semantics.
